_comment: Curated outreach-channel registry (question-router plan §5.7). Static knowledge artifact, refreshed ~monthly like geo_playbook.md / qc_sitemaps.json. feasibility: open (self-serve channel exists) | gated (application/approval required) | closed (no direct channel - earn the slot indirectly).

reddit.com.mechanism: Post authentic expert answers / host an AMA as a named QC account.

quora.com.mechanism: Answer relevant questions from a verified QC expert profile.

facebook.com.mechanism: Participate in relevant groups as a named QC presence; no anonymous posts.

coursera.org.mechanism: Apply to Coursera's partner/content program (approval required).

udemy.com.mechanism: Publish QC-branded introductory courses on the platform.

classcentral.com.mechanism: Submit QC courses to the Class Central catalog.

coursereport.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC school profile; solicit alumni reviews.

careerkarma.com.mechanism: Request a school listing/partnership (editorial approval required).

switchup.org.mechanism: Claim the QC school listing; solicit verified reviews.

g2.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC vendor profile; solicit reviews.

capterra.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC vendor profile; solicit reviews.

trustpilot.com.mechanism: Claim the QC business profile; invite reviews.

wikipedia.org.mechanism: No direct edits (COI). Earn a citation by publishing a source editors can reference.

wikidata.org.mechanism: No promotional edits. Ensure QC's structured facts exist in citable primary sources.

britannica.com.mechanism: Not reachable. Benchmark the authority; align QC content.

gov_tld.mechanism: Not reachable. Benchmark the authority; align QC content.
